benchmarks_info.description: Nonlinear-boundary stress prompts for the Spline-CLT hypothesis. Each task is constructed so the FOIL is the linear shortcut (a token literally present in the prompt, or the other word-sense / truth-value), while the CORRECT token requires applying a nonlinear operator (negation/opposite, context-gated sense selection, boolean interaction, or a close-in-embedding-space discrimination). A linear encoder keyed on 'token X is present' is biased toward the foil; recovering the correct minimal faithful set should be where a KAN encoder earns its parameters.
benchmarks_info.usage: Same schema as acdc_benchmark_prompts.json. Use clean_prompt for the forward pass; score first-token logit gap between correct_token and incorrect_token. correct_token / incorrect_token first tokens differ (the greater_than degeneracy is avoided).
